_comment: Edit decisions for edit.mjs, trailer v3 ("Big Plays", 144 BPM: 25 frames per beat). Frame numbers are each cut's own (60 fps). The shot list is shots.mjs, the 15 s mapping is CUT15_SEGMENTS in mg-timeline.mjs, flashes/shakes/rgbashift/bumps come from post() there. Speed ramps are baked in at capture (real in-engine time scaling), so the edit never retimes footage.

grade._comment: Storyboard v2 §3: CAS 0.35; eq contrast 1.10, saturation 1.10; gentle S-curve; warm highlights; 16 % vignette; a highlight bloom (luma >= 0.82 keyed, gblur σ 18, added at 0.22) so skill FX glow on the sunny palette; grain 3. Type is composited after the grade. Redo: the bloom keys only the brightest highlights (>= 0.88) at 0.12, so pale plazas never wash out. v3: a highlight soft-clip in the S-curve (0.92 -> 0.88, 1 -> 0.94) and the bloom keys only >= 0.9 at 0.1, so white plazas, shockwave bands and hit flashes never blow out (<= 10 % of a frame at Y >= 235).

chroma._comment: rgbashift. strong (4 px) = post().rgb impact frames; light (2 px) = transition accents on the whip, the match cut and the big impacts.

push._comment: Digital push-ins: none. S19 is the gameplay camera 1:1 with its full HUD; S13's wheel and S14's bark are framed natively.

bump._comment: Zoom-punch (§3): 104 % scale-in over 3 frames, then out over 8 (the impact frames in post().bump).

band._comment: v3: none (the landscape HUD beat is 16:9 only; the 9:16 card-look shot runs on over it).

poster._comment: Thumbnails: Lambo mid-air in the Belly Flop (S01 f4) with the logo and end-card lines from the 30 s overlay.

audio._comment: Mix from score.mjs stems: the music ducks under the sfx + game sounds (impacts), then glue, gain to -14 LUFS, a latency-free true-peak limiter, the end fade and digital silence.
audio._tp: the WAV must measure <= maxTruePeakWavDb so the AAC encode stays <= maxTruePeakDb
audio._sections: Energy curve v3 [from, to, dB] (8-frame ramps), before the glue: no trough in the middle (title, 3V3 and the mid bars stay within 3 dB of the chorus), Pack Hunt a little under, TAKE THEIR CORE into the tape stop, the core burst +3 over the chorus (the loudest moment), Victory and the end card under it.
audio._bed: v3: the music stem is limited at its own RMS + bedCrestDb before the mix, so the master ceiling is reached by the designed impacts only (crest over 14 dB at -14 LUFS).
